content.short: FormFunction is a digital art marketplace for Solana.
content.description: FormFunction, launched in February 2022 by Katherine Liu and Matt Lim, is a Solana NFT marketplace where users can explore, collect, and view work by independent artists. The platform gives developers access to creator statistics and invites users to submit feature requests to guide updates. Since its inception, FormFunction has paid artists more than $1 million, underscoring its commitment to supporting creators and sustaining creator-led activity within the NFT ecosystem.
